title: Bridge to Green: Reliability Program Playbook and Workshop Series
content:
Executive summary:

Bridge to Green is a 6-week cross-functional program and workshop series aimed at accelerating SLO adoption and operational readiness for 8 priority services. The program combines hands-on workshops, sprint-zero deliverables, and lightweight runbook prototypes to reduce time-to-stable for customer-facing routes. This doc is a playbook for program leads and stakeholders to coordinate work, measure outcomes, and make rollout decisions.

Objectives:
- Move 8 priority services from ‘monitoring-only’ to ‘SLO-backed, tested, and runbooked’ within 6 weeks.
- Establish repeatable artifacts (telemetry spec, alert-to-slo mapping, 1-page runbook template) that can be reused by other teams.
- Validate rollback and fallback behavior for degraded model variants via tabletop simulation.

Scope (what’s in / out):
- In scope: defining service-level objectives (latency, availability), telemetry adjustments, alert-to-SLO mappings, canary & fallback playbooks, and a minimal audit trail for SLO decisions.
- Out of scope: full automation of rollout (we’ll document ops steps but not ship automation in this phase), on-prem private deployment changes, and infra procurement.

Program-level success metrics:
- 8/8 services with defined SLOs and documented error budgets (pass/fail).
- Automated SLI collection for 6/8 services at 1-minute granularity.
- Tabletop simulation run with post-mortem and improvement items for each service.
- <20% of runbook actions requiring changes during first live exercise.

Primary stakeholders:
- Program lead: Aisha Patel (eng-sre)
- Observability lead: Marcus Lee (observability)
- Product owner cohort: Priya Sharma (product-hosted-api), Diego Alvarez (product-dedicated)
- Solutions/SE liaison: Carmen Ruiz (solutions-engineering)
- Engineering leads for priority services (see attached list / JIRA epic)

Audience: SREs, service owners (backend), product managers for affected services, support on-call leads, incident commanders.

Workshop series (5 sessions, each 2 hours, once weekly):
1) Kickoff & problem framing (week 1)
   - Goals: align on program success metrics, confirm 8 priority services, introduce templates.
   - Deliverable: signed service roster + baseline telemetry gap list.
   - Prework for participants: bring current dashboards and recent incidents.

2) Signal & SLI design (week 2)
   - Goals: define SLIs, failure modes, cardinal SLI queries, and sampling/aggregation rules.
   - Deliverable: per-service SLI spec (1 pager) and dashboard mock.

3) SLO target-setting & error budget policy (week 3)
   - Goals: pick SLO targets with product tradeoffs, set error budget burn policies (paused releases, on-call escalation).
   - Deliverable: SLO document with target, measurement window, burn thresholds.

4) Runbooks, fallbacks & tabletop (week 4)
   - Goals: draft runbooks, test rollback & fallback behavior with model variants, run tabletop for 2 services.
   - Deliverable: runbook 1-pager + tabletop playbook outputs.

5) Rollout criteria, cadence & retrospective (week 5)
   - Goals: finalize rollout gating (canary thresholds), define monitoring cadence, and capture improvements.
   - Deliverable: rollout checklist and program retro notes.

Sprint-zero deliverables (to be completed in parallel with workshops):
- Telemetry gap remediation plan for each service (owner + ETA).
- Instrumentation PRs opened for SLI collection (minimum viable queries).
- Runbook template filled with initial data (symptoms, mitigation, rollback steps).
- Tabletop scenario bank (3 failure scenarios per service).

RACI (high level):
- Responsible: Service engineers (define SLIs, implement queries); Observability (validate metrics ingest & dashboards); SRE (review SLOs, lead tabletop).
- Accountable: Program lead (Aisha).
- Consulted: Product owners, Solutions engineering, Security (if PII telemetry).
- Informed: Customer success, Support on-call, Exec sponsor.

Timeline (6-week plan):
- Week 0: pre-kickoff signups, baseline data collection (dashboards), finalize service roster.
- Weeks 1–5: weekly workshops + sprint-zero tasks.
- Week 6: final tabletop exercises across remaining services + program closeout and handoff.

Communication plan:
- Weekly sync + 30-min follow-up office hours after each workshop.
- Program Slack channel: #bridge-to-green (invite list in linked_confluence page).
- Program dashboard (obs board link) updated after each workshop with progress checkboxes.

Risks and mitigation:
- Risk: telemetry gaps take longer than expected -> Mitigation: prioritize a ‘core SLI’ with degraded granularity for short term.
- Risk: product disagreements on targets -> Mitigation: escalation path to product cohort lead and product director.
- Risk: on-call bandwidth limited -> Mitigation: schedule tabletop in off-peak window and pair SRE with service engineer.

Dependencies:
- Observability storage quotas and 1-minute retention (tracking JIRA-RBG-1023).
- Access to model variant routing configs (solutions/infra owners).
- SE time for canary policy review.

Open questions / decisions needed:
- Do we standardize measurement window at 30 days or 7 days for initial SLOs? (product leads)
- Which degradation modes qualify as ‘degraded but acceptable’ vs ‘incident’? (ops + product)
- Approval authority for changing SLO targets post-launch? (exec sponsor vs product director)

Post-program artifacts to hand off:
- Per-service SLI/SLO doc (finalized)
- Runbook 1-pagers with quick links to dashboards and playbooks
- Tabletop After Action Reports with action items tracked in JIRA epic
- Program retro with process improvements and onboarding checklist for future service cohorts

Appendix A: Runbook 1-page template (quick view)
- Service name, owner, contact
- Symptom(s) and quick checks
- Known root causes & quick mitigations
- Canary rollback steps (3 bullets)
- Communication template (Slack/Status page)

Appendix B: Example SLI query snippets (placeholder, teams must adapt)
- availability: sum(success_count)/sum(total_count) over window
- p95 latency: histogram_quantile(0.95, rate(request_latency_bucket[5m]))

Next steps (immediate):
- Confirm service roster by 2026-02-16 (owners to reply in Slack)
- Book workshop calendar invites and reserve room + video link
- Observability to run baseline queries and surface obvious telemetry gaps by 2026-02-18

Notes to self / working items: 
- Need to sync with legal on telemetry retention policy for derived customer identifiers.
- Consider lightweight automation to map alerts -> SLO burn in future phase (unscoped now).
- Keep runbooks intentionally short; longer runbooks don’t get used in fire.

Document history and edits:
- 2026-02-12 created by Aisha Patel (initial charter and workshop plan)
- 2026-02-20 added telemetry snippets and sprint-zero checklist (Marcus Lee)
- 2026-03-02 updated timeline and added tabletop plan (Priya Sharma)

Unresolved: tie-in with Dedicated deployment SLA wording (need legal/product review, ticket CONFLUENCE-4567).

Action items (short):

- [Marcus] baseline queries and gap list by 2026-02-18.
- [Diego] confirm product owners availability for week 3 target-setting by 2026-02-19.
